article_illusion_knowledge.summary: The easier it is to find an answer, the more people believe they knew it all along. This article explains the illusion of knowledge: how search engines and AI feed the Dunning–Kruger effect, why confirmation bias feels like being right, and how to tell the difference between having information and having understanding.
article_illusion_knowledge.title: The Illusion of Knowledge: Why Easy Answers Feel Like Truth
